testCase:
T-03: Columns with almost the same name
Goal: Tell me the start time and the price including VAT of Jazz Night.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/t-03/
STEP 2: Find the row "Jazz Night" and read its "Start time" and its "Price incl. VAT"
STEP 3: Fill "Answer" with the start time, a slash and the price incl. VAT, for example "20:00 / 10.00"
STEP 4: Click "Check answer"
STEP 5: Verify "Correct: Jazz Night starts at 19:30 and costs 22.99 with VAT" is visible

plan.title: Jazz Night start time and VAT-inclusive price

steps.note: Read the expected start-time text in the Jazz Night row.
Read the expected VAT-inclusive price text in the Jazz Night row.
Enter the values supplied by the case in the required format.

args.text: Correct: Jazz Night starts at 19:30 and costs 22.99 with VAT

steps.note: Verify the exact requested success message.

reasoning: This tests the Jazz Night start time and VAT-inclusive price rather than similarly named fields. The answer values are explicitly supplied by the final expected message, so the plan needs no unsupported substitution of remembered text.
